title: Agent Package (agent.yaml)
description: The minimum publishable product of an agentic platform. Origen: M32.3. Every package answers five questions before it runs with real users or real data: what it does, for whom, with which permissions, how I know it works, and what I do when it fails. The manifest feeds CI/CD, the catalogue console, dynamic permissions, observability and the compliance dossier.

id.description: Stable identifier. The `.vN` suffix is only the major.

owner.description: Who answers for this agent. Without an owner there is no incident response.

risk_tier.$comment: Same scale as schemas/autonomy-levels.yaml and as the manifest's risk_tier: one scale, three artifacts (M21.4). An agent inherits the highest rung any of its tools_allowed can reach.

channels.description: The surfaces this agent serves. Each surface carries its own transparency obligation (16.5), so an undeclared channel is an unclassified use case.

models.description: role -> gateway alias. Aliases only: a provider id here is a defect, not a shortcut (0.5, 19.2). The alias is also the transfer control, because a fallback chain can cross a jurisdiction (16.4).

tools_allowed.description: The capabilities this agent may call, each with its own manifest. Not 'every available tool' (M20.4).

memory_scopes.description: What it may read from memory and what it may write. A generic write-anything scope is not a scope.

release_gate.description: Path to the Eval Card that blocks this agent's release. Validated against schemas/eval-card.schema.json.

human_in_the_loop.description: What I do when it must not act alone. Every L4 tool in tools_allowed appears in required_for, or the ladder is decoration (A·H, autonomy-ladder R5). An empty list is a legitimate declaration for a read-only agent, but it is declared.

slo.description: What I do when it fails, measured. The three properties named here are the ones M32.3 declares; other objectives are domain-specific (a batch agent declares a deadline instead of a p95, M30.2), so further keys are allowed and at least one is required.

allOf.$comment: A·H, L4: an agent that can reach an irreversible or regulated action declares its human barrier. An empty required_for at that tier does not validate.
